summary.text: Brandon Dukes is the Democratic state representative for Pennsylvania House District 12 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
He won the August 18, 2026 special general election for the seat and assumed office on September 8, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Dukes said he works in the commercial construction side of banking and has been in the financial industry for 16 years.

paragraphs.text: Brandon Dukes graduated from Seton La Salle High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Pittsburgh in 2008.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in Pittsburgh and studied political science at Pitt.
In the survey, Dukes listed affordability, infrastructure and education as the three key messages of his campaign.
He said he is also passionate about voting rights and reform, healthcare, safety measures and governmental transparency.
